title: Configuration switch OpenRouter -> Foundry (zero-code environment switching)

test_cases.name: Default provider resolves to Foundry
test_cases.input_setup: Call build_llm_provider() without LLM_PROVIDER environment variable set
test_cases.expected_result: Returns FoundryLLMProvider as the default enterprise provider
test_cases.evidence: Default provider without env override is FoundryLLMProvider

test_cases.name: Environment switch to OpenRouter
test_cases.input_setup: Set LLM_PROVIDER=openrouter in environment and invoke build_llm_provider()
test_cases.expected_result: Returns OpenRouterLLMProvider instance without code modifications
test_cases.evidence: Switched cleanly to OpenRouterLLMProvider via LLM_PROVIDER=openrouter

test_cases.name: Invalid provider rejection with valid choices
test_cases.expected_result: Raises ValueError detailing valid supported providers
test_cases.evidence: Invalid provider rejected with descriptive error: Unknown LLM_PROVIDER: 'nonexistent_vendor'. Supported options: ['foundry', 'openrouter']

test_cases.name: STT provider switch to Voxtral
test_cases.evidence: STT provider switched seamlessly to VoxtralSTTProvider via environment

test_cases.name: Dynamic runtime switch without stale cache
test_cases.input_setup: Instantiate provider, reset singleton cache, update env, and re-query factory
test_cases.expected_result: New provider instantiated immediately; old cached instance discarded
test_cases.evidence: Runtime reset and re-invocation correctly returns new provider without stale cache
